## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

Textual reuse data computed by DharmaNexus demonstrates substantial overlap between Ne 7 and other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. Within the canonical strata, the chapter quotes and shares passages with the Aṅguttara Nikāya, specifically the *Dasakanipāta* (AN 10, e.g. §4.1_4–4.1_7 matching AN 10.1), the *Ekādasakanipāta* (AN 11, e.g. §4.1_4–4.2 matching AN 11.1), the *Sattakanipāta* (AN 7), and the Vinaya *Parivāra* (Pvr 14) [DharmaNexus]. It also exhibits extensive parallel text reuse with the kindred exegetical treatise *Peṭakopadesa*, most notably the *Suttatthasamuccayabhūmi* (Pe 6, with 44 matches comprising over 6,400 characters, such as §3.5–3.14 matching Pe 6 §10.5–10.14), as well as the *Hāravibhaṅgapañcamabhūmi* (Pe 5) and *Hārasampātabhūmi* (Pe 8) [DharmaNexus]. Internally, it shares textual material with other *Netti* sections, including the *Vibhattihāravibhaṅga* (Ne 11) and *Parikkhārahāravibhaṅga* (Ne 18) [DharmaNexus]. Subsequent Pali literature quoting or commenting on the chapter includes the *Nettippakaraṇa-aṭṭhakathā*, the sub-commentary *Nettivibhāvinī*, the *Visuddhimagga*, and the *Vinayavinicchayaṭīkā* [DharmaNexus]. In cross-language matches, DharmaNexus automatically aligns segments of Ne 7 with passages in the Sanskrit *Madhyamakaśālistambasūtra* and Tibetan versions of canonical and scholastic works, including the *Lokadharaparipṛcchāsūtra* (D0174), *Saddharmānusmṛtyupasthāna* (D0287-4), *Saṃskṛtāsaṃskṛtaviniścaya* (D3897), and the *Yogācārabhūmi Viniścayasaṃgrahaṇī* (D4038) [DharmaNexus].
